raw_text:
Here’s the complete 12-week plan summary (training, cardio, nutrition, recovery), aligned to her cycle and flare windows, with all guardrails observed.

Key constraints and dates
- No HIIT, no heavy Valsalva, no jumping on flow or flare days.
- Expected periods (27-day cycle): ~May 31, Jun 27, Jul 24, Aug 20 (approximate).
- Reported flare windows: Jul 10–13 (Week 6), Aug 4–7 (Week 10).
- Weekly template (adjust around symptoms): 5 days/week
  - S1 Strength Lower, S2 Conditioning/Cardio + Mobility, S3 Strength Upper + Core, S4 Conditioning/Cardio + Mobility (or metabolic intervals), S5 Full-Body Strength.
  - 2 rest days; swap session order to keep flow/flare days as EZ cardio/mobility.

Phase overview
- Phase 1 (Weeks 1–4): Foundation and tolerance. Submax strength (RPE 6–7), aerobic base. Deload near late Week 4 (around expected flow).
- Phase 2 (Weeks 5–8): Progressive strength and higher aerobic intensity on non-flow/non-flare days (tempo and sub-HIIT metabolic intervals). Deload Week 8 (expected flow).
- Phase 3 (Weeks 9–12): Consolidate strength with tempo/volume; manage around Week 10 flare; taper Week 12 (expected flow). End with submax testing (3–5RM/e1RM), not true 1RM.

Warm-up and cooldown (every session)
- Warm-up 10–12 min: 3–5 min easy cardio; mobility (hips/T‑spine); glute activation (clamshells/bridges); 2 min diaphragmatic breathing.
- Cooldown 5–8 min: easy cardio; 2–3 hip/low-back mobility drills; 2 min downregulation breathing.
- Pelvic floor/core: exhale on exertion; gentle 360° brace; avoid breath holds.

Strength plan (by week; sessions 45–60 min)

Week 1 (Jun 1–7) – Phase 1
- S1 Lower: Goblet squat 3x8, RDL 3x8, Hip thrust 3x10, Step-up 3x8/leg, Clamshell 2x12/side, Calf 2x12 (RPE ~6).
- S3 Upper + Core: Incline DB press 3x8, 1-arm row 3x10/side, Pulldown 3x8–10, Face pull 3x12, Lateral raise 2x12, Dead bug 3x6/side, Side plank 2x20–30s.
- S5 Full-Body: FFESS 3x8/leg, DB bench 3x8, Cable pull-through 3x10, Seated row 3x10, Pallof 2x10/side, Farmer carry light 3x30–40 m.

Week 2 (Jun 8–14)
- S1 Lower: Goblet/front box squat 3x8, RDL 3x8, Hip thrust 3x10 (1s pause), Reverse lunge 3x8/leg, Banded walks 2x12/side, Calf 3x12.
- S3 Upper + Core: Incline DB press 4x6–8, 1-arm row 4x8/side, Assisted pull-up or pulldown 3x8, Landmine half-kneel press 3x8/side, Face pull 3x12, Dead bug 3x6/side, Pallof hold 2x20s/side.
- S5 Full-Body: Leg press 3x10 or FFESS 3x8/leg, KB hinge 3x10, DB bench 3x8, Lat pulldown 3x8–10, Side plank 2x30s, Farmer carry 3x40–50 m.

Week 3 (Jun 15–21)
- S1 Lower: Goblet/safety bar squat 4x6–8 (RPE 7), RDL 4x6–8, Hip thrust 3x8–10, Step-up 3x8/leg, Clamshell 2x15.
- S3 Upper + Core: DB bench 4x6–8, 1-arm row 4x8, Pulldown 3x8, Seated DB shoulder press 3x8 (light), Face pull 3x12, Dead bug 3x8/side, Bird dog 2x6/side.
- S5 Full-Body: FFESS 3x8/leg, Cable pull-through 3x12, Incline DB press 3x8, Chest-supported row 3x10, Pallof 2x12/side, Calf 3x12–15.

Week 4 (Jun 22–28) – Deload (expected flow ~Jun 27)
- Pre-flow S1 Lower: Box squat 3x6 (RPE 6), RDL 3x6, Hip thrust 2x8, Step-up 2x8/leg, Clamshell 2x12.
- Pre-flow S3 Upper + Core: DB bench 3x6 (light), 1-arm row 3x8, Pulldown 2x8–10, Lateral raise 2x12, Dead bug 2x6/side, Side plank 2x20s.
- S5 Full-Body (skip if on flow): Circuit 2–3 rounds at RPE ≤6: Goblet squat 8, Seated row 10, KB hinge 10, Cable press 8/side, Pallof 10/side.

Week 5 (Jun 29–Jul 5) – Phase 2 build
- S1 Lower: Front squat or goblet 4x6 (RPE 7), RDL 4x6, Hip thrust 3x8, Step-up 3x8/leg, Calf 3x12.
- S3 Upper + Core: Incline DB press 4x6, Chest-supported row 4x8, Pulldown 3x8, Landmine press 3x8/side, Face pull 3x12, Dead bug 3x8/side.
- S5 Full-Body: Leg press 3x10, DB bench 3x8, Cable pull-through 3x12, 1-arm row 3x10/side, Pallof 3x10/side.

Week 6 (Jul 6–12) – Build early; flare Jul 10–13
- Early-week S1 Lower: Squat 4x5–6 (RPE 7), RDL 4x6, Hip thrust 3x8, Reverse lunge 3x8/leg.
- Early-week S3 Upper + Core: DB bench 4x5–6, 1-arm row 4x8, Pulldown 3x8, Lateral raise 3x12, Dead bug 3x6–8/side.
- Flare days: replace remaining sessions with gentle cardio + mobility (see Cardio) or light circuit x2 at RPE ≤5.

Week 7 (Jul 13–19) – Post-flare re-entry
- S1 Lower: Box/goblet squat 3x6–8 (RPE 6–7), RDL 3x6–8, Hip thrust 3x10 (light), Step-up 2x8/leg.
- S3 Upper + Core: Incline DB press 3x6–8, Chest-supported row 3x8–10, Pulldown 3x8–10, Face pull 3x12, Dead bug 3x6/side, Side plank 2x20–30s.
- S5 Full-Body: FFESS 3x8/leg, Cable pull-through 3x12, DB bench 3x8, Seated row 3x10, Pallof 2x12/side, Calf 3x12.

Week 8 (Jul 20–26) – Deload (expected flow ~Jul 24)
- S1 Lower: Leg press 3x8–10, KB RDL 3x8, Hip thrust 2x10, Step-up 2x8/leg (RPE ≤6).
- S3 Upper + Core: Machine chest press 3x8, Seated row 3x10, Pulldown 2x8–10, Lateral raise 2x12, Dead bug 2x6/side.
- S5 Full-Body (skip if on flow): Light circuit 2–3 rounds, RPE ≤6.

Week 9 (Jul 27–Aug 2) – Phase 3 tempo emphasis
- S1 Lower: Goblet squat 4x6 @ 3-1-1 tempo (RPE 7), RDL 4x6 @ 3-1-1, Hip thrust 3x8 (1s pause), Step-up 3x8/leg.
- S3 Upper + Core: Incline DB press 4x6 @ tempo, 1-arm row 4x8, Pulldown 3x8, Landmine press 3x8/side, Face pull 3x12, Dead bug 3x8/side.
- S5 Full-Body: FFESS 3x8/leg, Cable pull-through 3x12, DB bench 3x8, Chest-supported row 3x10, Pallof 3x10/side.

Week 10 (Aug 3–9) – Flare Aug 4–7
- Pre-flare S1 Lower (Mon): Squat 3x5–6 (RPE 6–7), RDL 3x6, Hip thrust 2–3x8, Reverse lunge 2x8/leg.
- Post-flare S3 Upper + Core (Sat/Sun): DB bench 3x6–8 (light), 1-arm row 3x8–10, Pulldown 2–3x8–10, Face pull 2x12, Dead bug 2x6/side.
- Replace other sessions during flare with EZ cardio + mobility.

Week 11 (Aug 10–16) – Rebuild, slight progress
- S1 Lower: Goblet/front squat 4x6 (RPE 7), RDL 4x6, Hip thrust 3x8–10, Step-up 3x8/leg.
- S3 Upper + Core: Incline DB press 4x6, Chest-supported row 4x8, Pulldown 3x8, Landmine press 3x8/side, Lateral raise 2x12, Dead bug 3x8/side.
- S5 Full-Body: FFESS 3x8/leg, Cable pull-through 3x12, DB bench 3x8, Seated row 3x10, Pallof 3x10/side, Calf 3x12–15.

Week 12 (Aug 17–23) – Taper/test week (expected flow ~Aug 20; schedule tests away from flow)
- S1 Lower: Box squat 3x6, KB RDL 3x6–8, Hip thrust 2–3x8, Step-up 2x8/leg (RPE 6–7).
- Testing (non-flow, non-flare day; 48–72 h apart upper/lower):

Cardio plan (aerobic base with Phase 2 intensity; all low impact; EZ only on flow/flare)

Phase 1 (Weeks 1–4)
- W1: S2 35 min EZ; S4 35 min EZ (optional 4 x 20s strides if symptom-free); optional 20–25 min EZ on a rest day.
- W2: S2 40 min EZ; S4 40 min EZ (optional 5 x 20–30s strides); optional 20–25 min EZ.
- W3: S2 45 min EZ; S4 40–45 min EZ with last 10 min STEADY.
- W4 (deload): S2 30–35 min EZ; S4 30–35 min EZ; no strides/tempo.

Phase 2 (Weeks 5–8) — “Push” intensity on non-flow, non-flare days
- W5: S2 50 min with 3 x 8 min TEMPO (4 min EZ between). S4 45–50 min with 4 x 6 min upper STEADY/low TEMPO (3 min EZ). Optional 20–25 min EZ on a rest day.
- W6 (flare Jul 10–13): Early-week S2 45–50 min with 2 x 10 min TEMPO (5 min EZ). During flare: 20–30 min very EZ only; no tempo.
- W7: S2 55–60 min: 15–20 min EZ + 20–25 min continuous TEMPO + 10–15 min EZ. S4 50–55 min with 8 x 3 min high STEADY/low TEMPO (2 min EZ).
- W8 (deload/flow): S2 35–40 min EZ; S4 35–40 min EZ.

Phase 3 (Weeks 9–12)
- W9: S2 50 min EZ with last 10–12 min STEADY; S4 50–55 min with 2 x 10 min TEMPO (5 min EZ).
- W10 (flare Aug 4–7): Mon S2 45 min EZ; Tue–Fri 20–30 min very EZ only; weekend S4 35–40 min EZ.
- W11: S2 50–55 min EZ with last 12–15 min STEADY; S4 55–60 min with 1 x 12–15 min TEMPO, 5 min EZ, 1 x 8–10 min TEMPO.
- W12 (taper/flow): S2 40–45 min EZ; S4 35–45 min EZ; no tempo.

Weekly “metabolic intervals” session (sub-HIIT; 1x/week on a non-flow, non-flare day)
- Warm-up: 8–10 min.
- Main set (choose modality): e.g., incline walk 6–8 x 2 min at RPE 6–7 (4–7% grade) with 2 min EZ; or bike 8 x 90s at RPE 6.5–7 with 90s EZ.
- Finisher (optional): light sled push + step-downs + med-ball chest pass circuit x2 at RPE ≤6.
- Progress in Weeks 5, 6 (pre-flare), 7, 9, 11 only; skip/deload Weeks 4, 8, 10, 12.
- Hard stop if pelvic heaviness/pressure, cramp uptick, or breathless (RPE >7).

Mobility/breathing menu (rotate 10–15 min on S2/S4 and during flares/flow)
- 90/90 transitions, hip flexor and adductor rock backs, thoracic open books, cat–cow.
- Supine diaphragmatic breathing with 360° expansion; 4–6 s inhale, 6–8 s exhale; 1–2 min pelvic floor relaxation cues.

Nutrition (anti-inflammatory; adjust portions to body size/goals)
- Protein: 1.6–2.0 g/kg/day; distribute across 3–4 meals.
- Carbs: moderate, mostly from potatoes/sweet potatoes, oats, quinoa, rice, fruit, and veg.
- Fats: 30–40% kcal with extra-virgin olive oil, avocado, nuts/seeds.
- Omega-3: 2–3 fatty-fish meals/week or EPA+DHA 1–2 g/day if cleared.
- Produce: 5–7+ servings/day; emphasize berries, leafy greens, crucifers.
- Around training: pre 25–45 g carbs + 15–25 g protein on intensity days; post 20–30 g protein + 40–70 g carbs.
- Flow/flare days: easy-to-digest meals (broths/soups, oatmeal/quinoa porridge, smoothies, baked fish/tofu, steamed veg), smaller frequent portions, ginger/peppermint teas.
- Limit: ultra-processed foods, added sugars, alcohol near flares; balance omega-6 oils; moderate caffeine.

Recovery and monitoring
- Sleep 7–9 h; consistent schedule.
- Hydration: 30–35 ml/kg/day; add electrolytes in heat or >60 min cardio.
- Heat therapy for pelvic/low-back comfort as needed.
- Walk 10–15 min after meals when possible.
- Track symptoms vs. training and foods across cycles; adjust loads to RPE 5–6 near flow/flare.
- Red flags: sharp pelvic pain, unusual bleeding, dizziness, or nausea beyond typical—modify or stop and coordinate with medical team if persistent.

Testing at end of Phase 3 (Week 12)
- Avoid true 1RM. Use 3–5RM top sets (RPE 8–9) to estimate 1RM, or AMRAP at ~75% with RPE 9 cap. Schedule 3–5 days away from flow and any flare; exhale on exertion, no breath holds.

- Use the template calendar: Mon S1 Lower, Tue S2 Cardio/Mobility, Wed Rest, Thu S3 Upper, Fri S4 Cardio/MetCon, Sat S5 Full-Body, Sun Rest. Shift sessions to place EZ cardio/mobility on flow/flare days and front‑load harder work before flare windows.
